IMMEDIATE

No. 55/4/CT-64(1)
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
CABINET SECRETARIAT
(Department of Cabinet Affairs)

New Delhi, the 9th June 1964.
---

The undersigned is directed to state that the Members
of the new Council of Ministers shown in the enclosed list
assumed office with effect from the forenoon of Tuesday, June 9,
1964.

(D. P. Chopra)
for Cabinet Secretary.

To.
All Members of the Council of Ministers.
---

Copy with a copy of the enclosure forwarded to the
Principal Private Secretary to the Prime Minister/the Private
Secretary to the Prime Minister, for information.
---

P.T.O.
